speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh
text: asked the Minister for Social and Family Development (a) how many applications have been received for HDB season parking for disabled car park lots since this scheme was implemented; (b) of these, how many applications are unsuccessful; and (c) what are the reasons for the unsuccessful applications.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: The Class 1 label allows drivers with disability to park in accessible parking lots for as long as they need, with no time limit.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: The Class 2 label allows the caregivers who are drivers to park in a designated lot for up to an hour, to assist their passenger with disability to board or alight, as the case may be.

speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: Thereafter, the vehicle must be shifted to a standard parking lot to free up the accessible lot for other eligible users who require it.
